title: Prime Property Guest Frontend Flow
purpose: Implementation guide for third-party web, mobile, and agent-built frontends that reproduce the public discovery and account experience without depending on Blade or Livewire internals.

global_rules.authentication: Bearer tokens only for v1. Tokens expire after 30 days and are scoped to the client ability.
global_rules.visibility: Every property returned by v1 has an active property detail. Every article returned by v1 is published.
global_rules.localization: Use /languages for discovery and /languages/{locale}?layout={layout} for a fallback-complete dictionary.

layouts.guest: Classic layout. Home omits the near-school section and uses a compact section treatment.
layouts.guest_v2: Newer editorial layout. Home includes all default sections, including near-school, and uses section dividers. Data semantics are otherwise identical.

global_rules.response_shape: Single resources use data; paginated resources use data, links, and meta; errors use message, code, and optional errors.

flows.name: Application shell
flows.purpose: Initialize branding, feature availability, locale/layout choices, navigation, footer contacts, and authentication affordances before rendering a page.
elements: Footer social links and phone/email contacts
transitions: Navigation opens home, property catalog, articles, or legal content
Locale/layout changes refresh dictionary and page data
Profile entry opens login for guests or profile for token users
flows.authentication: Optional. Supplying a valid bearer token enables user-aware data; an invalid supplied token is rejected.
flows.states: Render structural defaults if optional media/contact arrays are empty. On bootstrap failure, show a retry state and avoid guessing feature availability.
flows.layout_difference: Both layouts share the same shell data; presentation and translation dictionary differ.

flows.name: Home discovery
flows.purpose: Introduce the marketplace and move visitors into search, curated listings, locations, agents, testimonials, or enquiry-oriented content.
transitions: Hero search opens the property catalog with snake-case filters
Property cards open property detail
Agent/contact controls begin external contact actions
flows.authentication: Optional; valid tokens add is_favorited state.
flows.states: Hide empty optional sections rather than displaying blank carousels. Keep search available if editorial media is absent.
flows.layout_difference: guest uses recommendations, latest projects, near MRT, luxury, and budget sections. guest_v2 also includes near-school and uses divided editorial sections.

flows.name: Property filters and search
flows.purpose: Find active properties using text, intent, type, project status, hierarchical location, price, rooms, facilities, and quick filters.
elements: Residential, near-school, budget, condominium, sustainable, and pet-friendly quick filters
transitions: Filter changes reload the paginated collection
Selecting a result opens property detail
Map action opens the same result set geographically
flows.authentication: Optional; valid tokens add is_favorited state and may expose favorite controls.
flows.states: Show a clear no-results state with controls to broaden location, budget, or quick filters. Preserve applied filters after validation/server errors.
flows.layout_difference: Behavior and API parameters are identical; control composition differs visually.

flows.name: Property map
flows.purpose: Display up to 500 active matching properties as geographic markers, optionally constrained by viewport bounds.
transitions: Moving the viewport requests bounded markers
Selecting a marker opens a preview
Preview opens property detail
flows.authentication: Optional; valid tokens add is_favorited state.
flows.states: If coordinates are unavailable or no markers match, retain the map and offer a return to list/search. Treat mapping-provider failures separately from API failures.

flows.name: Property detail, enquiry, and favorites
flows.purpose: Explain one active listing completely and support conversion through agents, persisted enquiries, view tracking, and saved favorites.
transitions: Opening a detail records a view through the explicit view endpoint
Submitting the form creates an enquiry
Favorite prompts login when no token is available
Related cards continue discovery
flows.authentication: Reading and enquiry are public; favorite writes require a bearer token. Logged-in enquiry records the user automatically.
flows.states: 404 means the listing is absent or no longer active. Keep submitted enquiry values on validation failure. Treat idempotent favorite responses as authoritative.
flows.layout_difference: Same content contract; gallery, agent selector, and section arrangement differ.

flows.name: Article index
flows.purpose: Browse published editorial content, optionally scoped by a tag, with read-time and popularity context.
elements: Image, author, excerpt, read time, and publication date
transitions: Tag selection reloads the index
Article card opens article detail
flows.states: Show an empty editorial state for tags with no current publications; invalid tags produce validation errors.
flows.layout_difference: Same content contract; card density and typography differ.

flows.name: Article detail
flows.purpose: Present a published article and continue discovery through popular readings, newer articles, and suggested active properties.
transitions: Opening records a view through the explicit endpoint
Tags return to filtered index
Suggested listings open property detail
flows.authentication: Public; a valid optional token can be sent to view tracking.
flows.states: 404 means missing or unpublished. Hide empty optional related groups.

flows.name: Legal pages
flows.purpose: Render administrator-managed privacy and terms content while preserving the source for clients that need their own renderer.
transitions: Shell/footer links open the corresponding legal document
flows.states: An empty source is valid and should render an unavailable-content message rather than fabricated policy text.

flows.name: Registration, login, and verification
flows.purpose: Create or authenticate a client account, issue a device-scoped 30-day token, and verify email using a six-digit code.
transitions: Registration immediately returns a token and queues a code
Login/Google returns a token
Verification updates user state
Password reset revokes all existing tokens and returns to login
flows.authentication: Registration/login/reset are public. Verification and resend require a bearer token. Unverified token users retain normal client access.
flows.states: Map field errors directly to controls. Forgot-password always gives a neutral accepted response. Expired/incorrect codes remain recoverable through resend.
flows.layout_difference: API flow is identical. Web LoginResponse redirects are session-specific and must not be used by API clients.

flows.name: Profile and token lifecycle
flows.purpose: Show and edit account identity, upload/remove avatar, and revoke the current or all device tokens.
transitions: Changing email clears verification and queues a new code
Avatar upload uses multipart form data
Token revocation returns to signed-out shell
flows.authentication: Bearer token with client ability required.
flows.states: After email change, visibly prompt reverification. A revoked/expired token returns 401 and should clear local credentials.

flows.name: Favorites
flows.purpose: Maintain a user-specific active-property shortlist with idempotent writes.
transitions: Cards open property detail
Remove updates local state from the API response
Empty call-to-action returns to search
flows.authentication: Bearer token with client ability required.
flows.states: Inactive properties are omitted and cannot be added. Repeated PUT/DELETE calls succeed with the same final state.

flows.name: Newsletter
flows.purpose: Read, create/update, or remove the authenticated user’s newsletter subscription.
transitions: Subscribe writes the account email
Unsubscribe returns a false subscribed state
flows.authentication: Bearer token with client ability required. Submitted email must match the account email.
flows.states: A null data payload means no subscription. Email mismatch is a field validation error.

flows.name: AI property chat
flows.purpose: Answer Thailand real-estate questions and return machine-renderable property, location, subdistrict, or agent results without Blade HTML.
elements: Up to ten recent user/assistant turns
transitions: Typed property results open property detail
Location/subdistrict results start a filtered search
Agent results expose contact actions
flows.authentication: Public with optional bearer token. Limit is eight questions per hour keyed by user or IP/user-agent.
flows.states: 429 shows retry guidance. 503 indicates AI/service unavailability and should preserve the conversation for retry. Empty result text should invite broader criteria.
flows.layout_difference: No API data difference; each client renders the typed result objects in its own visual language.

implementation_notes: The root web route uses App\Livewire\Guest\HomePage.
resources/views/welcome.blade.php is unused Laravel starter markup.
Bot, Telegram, tag-search, old map-bounds, and web-authentication routes are intentionally outside v1.
